data.name: REGION55
data.detailed_description:
REGION55 is a fast-paced first-person shooter where players engage in brutal combat across tightly designed arenas. In Free-For-All (FFA) mode, it’s every player for themselves, only the one with the most frags before time runs out will emerge victorious. Weapon customization, unique tactical options, and diverse maps ensure no two matches play the same!

KEY FEATURES:

✔ Brutal FFA Mode – Fight against everyone, using the environment and tactics to survive.

✔ Weapon Customization – Modify barrels, stocks, scopes, attachments, and skins to suit your playstyle.

✔ 4 Unique Maps:

- "Abandoned Factory" – Tight corridors and open spaces for intense combat.

- "Panelki" – Plenty of cover and urban advantages.

- "Brick Buildings" – Destroyed buildings and dynamic firefights.

- "Village" – Balanced for close and long range combat.

✔ Fast & Responsive Gameplay – Smooth movement, realistic ballistics.

ADVANTAGES:

- Intense 5-Minute Matches – No long waits, just pure adrenaline.

- Balanced Weapons – No pay-to-win, victory depends on skill.

- Regular Updates – New maps, modes, weapons and cosmetics.

Are you ready to become the arena king? Jump in, pick your weapon, and prove you’re the best in chaotic FFA battles!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows® 10
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i3 8100
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1050
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 50 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows® 11
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5 12400
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 2060
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 50 GB available space
